photos.label: Front – driver side
photos.tip: Stand off the front corner on the driver (offside) side so the whole front and full driver side are in shot. Hold the phone landscape.

photos.label: Front – passenger side
photos.tip: Stand off the front corner on the passenger (nearside) side so the whole front and full passenger side are in shot. Landscape.

photos.label: Rear – passenger side
photos.tip: Stand off the rear corner on the passenger (nearside) side – whole rear and passenger side in shot. Landscape.

photos.label: Rear – driver side
photos.tip: Stand off the rear corner on the driver (offside) side – whole rear and driver side in shot. Landscape.

photos.label: Square – driver side
photos.tip: Stand level with the middle of the vehicle, square on to the driver side. Step back until the whole length fits. Landscape.

photos.label: Square – passenger side
photos.tip: Stand level with the middle of the vehicle, square on to the passenger side. Whole length in shot. Landscape.

photos.label: Square – rear
photos.tip: Stand directly behind the vehicle, centred. Whole rear in shot including number plate.

photos.label: Square – front
photos.tip: Stand directly in front, centred. Whole front in shot including number plate.

photos.label: VTG plating certificate
photos.tip: Photograph the plating certificate (or the Ministry plate on the chassis). Fill the frame, avoid glare – every line must be readable.

photos.label: MOT certificate
photos.tip: Current MOT / annual test certificate. Fill the frame, all text readable.

photos.label: ADR certificate
photos.tip: ADR certificate of approval. Fill the frame, all text readable.

photos.label: Safe loading pass certificate
photos.tip: Safe loading pass. Fill the frame, all text readable.

photos.label: Tank test certificate
photos.tip: Latest tank test certificate / tank test plate. Make sure dates are readable.

photos.label: Pump
photos.tip: Whole pump in shot, then get close enough that any make/model plate is visible.

photos.label: Axle hub
photos.tip: Close-up of a wheel hub showing the hub cap and condition.

photos.label: Brakes
photos.tip: Brake chamber / drum or disc through the wheel, showing condition.

photos.label: API couplers / compartment sizes
photos.tip: Show the API valves and the compartment capacity plates or markings.

photos.label: Control box
photos.tip: Control box with the door open, controls visible.

photos.label: Additional equipment
photos.tip: Any extra equipment (hose reels, meters, lockers etc.). If none, use “Can't take this photo”.

fields.label: Chassis number (VIN)
fields.hint: Usually 17 characters – check against the plate.

fields.label: Plated weight (GVW / GTW)
fields.hint: From the VTG plating certificate / plate.

fields.label: Axle manufacturer
fields.hint: The manufacturer on the axle plate or hub.

fields.label: Service history notes
fields.ph: e.g. main dealer, last service date and mileage
